I’ll make one focused improvement: derive today’s elapsed/remaining wake counts from the UTC-day schedule and format sub-minute countdowns with seconds. This keeps the dashboard accurate without changing the schedule or adding dependencies. I’ll also refresh the current wake stats and record the change in memory and recent tweaks.
